cites.quote: Rivlin met Monday with representatives of all 13 parties that won Knesset seats in the March 23 election. The 120 MKs were being sworn in on Tuesday afternoon.

reaction.policy: Only dated institutional steps and statements attributed to their speaker, applied to every list or to none.
reaction.gap: No reaction items collected for this pilot. Election-night statements by all 13 seated lists were not gathered, so none is shown (all-or-none rule).

cites.quote: After consulting with the representatives of all the factions in the Knesset, the following picture has emerged: 52 MKs requested that I entrust MK Benjamin Netanyahu with forming a government. 45 MKs requested that I entrust MK Yair Lapid with forming a government. 7 MKs requested that I entrust MK Naftali Bennett with forming a government. 16 MKs did not make any recommendation to me.

Netanyahu was endorsed by his Likud party, with 30 seats, Shas, with 9; United Torah Judaism, 7; and Religious Zionism, 6. Lapid was recommended as prime minister by 45 lawmakers (Yesh Atid 17, Blue and White 8, Yisrael Beytenu 7, Labor 7, Meretz 6), and Naftali Bennett by the seven members of his own Yamina party.
Yamina recommended its own party leader Naftali Bennett and Gideon Sa'ar's New Hope and the two Arab parties did not recommend anybody.
52 ממליצים ביקשו ממני להטיל את התפקיד על חבר הכנסת בנימין נתניהו

notes: The President's own statement is carried by ToI as "courtesy of the President's Residence"; the press release on the President's Residence site was not retrieved (gap).

knesset.nameEn: Return the task to the Knesset

cites.quote: I spoke with Bennett and Lapid and it was made clear to me that Bennett remains with seven recommendations while Lapid has 11 more recommendations and now has 56. MK Mansour Abbas wrote to me that he would cooperate with the person who received the most recommendations.

Lapid received 56 recommendations to be the next candidate to receive the mandate, including from Gideon Saar's New Hope party and five out of six MKs from the predominantly Arab Joint List. Yamina leader Naftali Bennett received seven nominations, with the 52-MK right-wing bloc headed by Netanyahu asking for the mandate to be returned to Knesset.
לפיד - 56, בנט - 7 ... פירוט: ליאיר לפיד - יש עתיד 17, כחול לבן 8, העבודה 7, ישראל ביתנו 7, תקווה חדשה 6, מרצ 6 וחמישה מחברי הרשימה המשותפת. לבנט - ימינה 7.
חד״ש ותע״ל תמכו בהחלטה זו ואילו בל״ד התנגדה

notes: Not a full new consultation round: the President described updated positions conveyed to him after the first mandate lapsed.

The five Joint List recommendations came from Hadash and Taal; Balad opposed the decision (Joint List letter quoted by Globes). Balad held one seat, Sami Abu Shehadeh. Raam (4) made no recommendation.

events.textEn: President Rivlin consulted all 13 Knesset lists.
events.textHe: הנשיא ריבלין התייעץ עם כל 13 הרשימות שנבחרו.

cites.quote: Rivlin met Monday with representatives of all 13 parties that won Knesset seats in the March 23 election.

events.textEn: Rivlin tasked Benjamin Netanyahu with forming a government (28 days).
events.textHe: ריבלין הטיל על בנימין נתניהו להרכיב ממשלה (28 ימים).

cites.quote: I have come to a decision based on the numbers of recommendations, which indicates that MK Benjamin Netanyahu has a slightly higher chance of forming a government. Accordingly, I have decided to entrust him with the task of doing so.
Netanyahu has been given 28 days to cobble together a coalition, with an option to ask Rivlin for a 14 day extension.

events.textEn: Netanyahu's 28 days ended at midnight without a government.
events.textHe: 28 הימים של נתניהו הסתיימו בחצות ללא ממשלה.

cites.quote: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's deadline for forming a government expired at midnight
after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu failed to do so in the 28 days allocated to him

events.textEn: Rivlin tasked Yair Lapid with forming a government (28 days).
events.textHe: ריבלין הטיל על יאיר לפיד להרכיב ממשלה (28 ימים).

cites.quote: As part of my powers, I have informed Lapid that I have granted him the task of forming a government in which he might head of or serve as alternate prime minister.
President Reuven Rivlin Wednesday announced that he has decided to task Yesh Atid leader Yair Lapid with forming Israel's next government.

events.textEn: Lapid informed the President, before midnight, that he had formed a government in which Bennett would serve as prime minister first.
events.textHe: לפיד הודיע לנשיא, לפני חצות, שהצליח להרכיב ממשלה שבה בנט יכהן ראשון כראש הממשלה.

cites.quote: I am honored to inform you that I have succeeded in forming a government ... The government will be an alternate government in accordance with Clause 13(a) of the Basic Law: The Government, and MK Naftali Bennett will serve as prime minister first.
Lapid spoke to the president on the phone and informed him that the government will comprise Yesh Atid, Blue and White, Yamina, Labor, Yisrael Beytenu, New Hope, Meretz and Ra'am.

events.textEn: The Knesset approved the 36th government, 60–59 with one abstention; ministers were sworn in.
events.textHe: הכנסת אישרה את הממשלה ה־36 ברוב של 60 מול 59 ונמנע אחד; השרים הושבעו.

cites.quote: By a vote of 60 to 59, with one abstention, the Knesset Plenum Sunday night confirmed the 36th Government of Israel headed by Prime Minister MK Naftali Bennett (Yemina). Following the vote, the government ministers were sworn in.
ח"כ עמיחי שיקלי מימינה הצביע נגד, וח"כ סעיד אלחרומי מרע"ם החליט ברגע האחרון להימנע

term.inclusionRuleNote: No retrospective chronology of 2021–22 by the Knesset, ISA or an encyclopaedia was retrieved. Interim rule: at least two independent sources, at least one official, each reporting the event at the time. Replace with the chronology rule when one is available. Audit correction: majority-lost-2022 and lebanon-maritime-2022 are explicit exceptions to the official-contemporary-source requirement: their event dates are corroborated by independent reporting, but no readable official contemporary departure/signing record was recovered. The 12 October government statement concerns tabling the agreement, not the 27 October signing. Advocacy organisations are excluded as chronology evidence.

events.textEn: The Knesset passed the 2021 state budget, 61–59, the first budget since 2018.
events.textHe: הכנסת אישרה את תקציב המדינה ל־2021, ברוב של 61 מול 59 – התקציב הראשון מאז 2018.

cites.quote: התקבל בכנסת ביום כ"ט בחשוון התשפ"ב (4 בנובמבר 2021)
The legislature voted 61-59 vote in favor of the 2021 budget
The NIS 609 billion ($194 billion) spending plan for 2021 is the first budget Israel has passed since 2018
העבירה תקציב מדינה

notes: The Reshumot citation is the accompanying Economic Plan law passed the same night; the Budget Law's own gazette entry was not retrieved.

events.textEn: The coalition lost its Knesset majority when Yamina MK Idit Silman left it.
events.textHe: הקואליציה איבדה את הרוב בכנסת לאחר שח״כ עידית סילמן מימינה פרשה ממנה.

cites.quote: אובדן הרוב הפרלמנטרי
6 April 2022, the Member of the Knesset (MK) Idit Silman
דיווח: קארה דן עם סילמן ושיקלי בהקמת סיעה
6 באפריל 2022: איבדו את הרוב

notes: Exception to the official-contemporary-source rule: contemporary Zman reporting, Ynet chronology and academic chronology corroborate the departure; no official contemporary record was readable. IDI independently selects the loss of majority. IPF advocacy timeline excluded.

events.textEn: The Knesset dissolved itself, 92–0, and set an election for 1 November 2022.
events.textHe: הכנסת התפזרה ברוב של 92 ללא מתנגדים וקבעה בחירות ל־1 בנובמבר 2022.

cites.quote: בקריאה השלישית תמכו 92 חברי כנסת ללא מתנגדים. מוצע לקבוע כי הכנסת העשרים וארבע תפוזר לפני גמר כהונתה, וכי הבחירות לכנסת העשרים וחמש תיערכנה ביום ז' בחשוון התשפ"ג, 1 בנובמבר 2022.
On June 30, 2022, the Knesset (Israel's parliament) approved the Law for the Dissolution of the 24th Knesset ... for national elections to take place on November 1, 2022.
Foreign Minister and Alternate Prime Minister Yair Lapid will formally succeed Prime Minister Naftali Bennett as premier at midnight between Thursday and Friday.

notes: Yair Lapid became prime minister on 1 July 2022 under the rotation agreement, not at the time of the 30 June vote.
יאיר לפיד נכנס לתפקיד ראש הממשלה ב־1 ביולי 2022 לפי הסכם הרוטציה, ולא במועד ההצבעה ב־30 ביוני.

events.textEn: Israel and Lebanon each signed a US-mediated maritime boundary agreement.
events.textHe: ישראל ולבנון חתמו, כל אחת בנפרד, על הסכם גבול ימי בתיווך ארה"ב.

cites.quote: Lebanese and Israeli leaders finalised a U.S.-brokered maritime demarcation deal on Thursday ... there was no joint signing ceremony
Earlier, Prime Minister Yair Lapid signed the deal in Jerusalem and Lebanese President Michel Aoun signed it in Beirut.
ראש הממשלה יאיר לפיד ונשיא לבנון מישל עאון חתמו היום, בנפרד, על הסכם הגבול הימי בין המדינות.

notes: Exception to the official-contemporary-source rule: independent contemporary reports support separate signing on 27 October; the 12 October official statement supports tabling only.
